buy_and_hold.description: Always holds the chosen funds in equal shares, with no signals and no move to cash; contributions top up whatever lags behind. The risk is the market's own: the S&P 500 fell as far as −54% in 2008–2009.
buy_and_hold.report.rebalance.name: Monthly contribution
buy_and_hold.report.rebalance.descriptio: Says what to buy with the contribution so the funds stay in equal shares.
buy_and_hold.rationale.title: What we hold
buy_and_hold.rationale.summary: The strategy holds all chosen funds whatever the market does.
